fields.instrument: Karnataka Sustainable Data Centre Policy 2026-2031, PUE incentive
fields.event_date_note: Date of The News Minute report on the policy text; policy approval 18 Sep 2026.

records.verbatim: Units achieving a PUE of 1.00 to 1.20 can receive Rs 20 crore as one-time financial support.
records.notes: Reporter's reading of the policy text; the PUE must be shown consistently for three years per the same article. Verify in the official policy before relying on the amount.

fields.event_date_note: Policy period start; the 2022 policy date itself is not stated in the source. Quoted as in force in April 2026.

records.verbatim: the state would facilitate provision of uninterrupted water supply (24*7) to data centre entities/units across the state.
records.notes: Quoted by Newslaundry from the policy text; the policy PDF itself was not fetched. Same article: BWSSB confirmed it has not tracked data-centre water as a separate category.

fields.event_date_note: Publication date of the Newslaundry investigation.

records.verbatim: consumes 169% of permissible extraction limits of water.
records.notes: Newslaundry investigation of groundwater use; the subject of the sentence is Devanahalli as a locality, which hosts multiple data centres. Not a company statement. Stance is curator judgment.

fields.event_date_note: Publication date of the Newslaundry report; the officials' remark is as reported there.

records.verbatim: the board has not tracked the water supplied to data centres
records.notes: Water board (BWSSB) officials, as reported by Newslaundry. Documents a reporting gap rather than a site-level finding.
